items.title: Leonard Williams: Inks extension with Seahawks
items.body_text: Williams has agreed to a three-year, $90 million contract extension with the Seahawks, Ian Rapoport of ESPN and NFL Network reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Cedric Tillman: Being released by Cleveland
items.body_text: Tillman (undisclosed) is in line to be released by the Browns, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Alec Pierce: To be activated from Active/PUP list
items.body_text: Pierce (ankle) is slated to be activated from the Active/PUP list Thursday, Mike Chappell of Fox 59 News Indianapolis reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: DK Metcalf: Agrees to restructured contract
items.body_text: Metcalf (undisclosed) has agreed to a restructured contract with the Steelers, Field Yates of ESPN reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tucker Kraft: Expected to be full-go Week 1
items.body_text: Kraft (knee) is expected to be "full go" for the Packers' Week 1 regular-season opener against the Vikings, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
